name: manual_a33c62
claim: On a shared branch with multiple concurrent agent sessions, always 'git fetch + git log HEAD..origin/<branch>' before starting substantial fix/review work — a gap you're about to fill may already be closed by a concurrent session, and duplicate work risks silent collision or wasted effort.

decisions.notes: Repeated 3+ times in one extended session on PR205/PR206: independently re-implemented an already-landed atomic-transaction fix (had to discard and pull the real one), redid CEO/Eng review synthesis another session had already completed and closed out, and nearly re-fixed already-resolved CodeRabbit review comments. Each time, a fetch+log check would have caught it before spending the work.
